name: Playwright MCP
description: Browser automation MCP server for AI-driven testing, screenshots, and web interaction.

envVars.description: HTTP MCP port exposed by the server
HTTP bind address inside the container

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{{envRaw.PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PORT}}:{{envRaw.PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PORT}}"
    environment:
      PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS: {{env.PLAYWRIGHT_HEADLESS}}
    command: ["--port", "{{envRaw.PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_PORT}}", "--host", "{{envRaw.PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_HOST}}"]
